items.title: Show HN: Discover AI tools based on your real workflow
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN! I built WorkMirror as a side-project because I was tired of generic “Top 10 AI Tools” lists that ignore how I actually work. WorkMirror is a browser extension that watches your real workflow for a few hours and recommends AI tools based on what you actually do. Ex: “You spent 2h 10m coding in Replit and switching files 74 times. Windsurf could cut context switching and save ~35 min/day.” It’s privacy-first: no accounts & it's free. The real challenge has been modeling workflow patterns reliably from noisy browser data. I’m using event timing + URL classification + interaction frequency to infer “work states” (coding, research, writing, idle) and feed those into a simple scoring model that ranks AI tools by expected time savings. Still iterating on the feature weighting and recommend

items.title: Build a proactive AI cost management system for Amazon Bedrock – Part 1

items.title: Fedora Will Allow AI-Assisted Contributions with Proper Disclosure Transparency
items.raw_excerpt: Fedora will now permit AI-assisted contributions with proper disclosure to maintain transparency and integrity in the open-source community.

title_i18n.en: Fedora Will Allow AI-Assisted Contributions with Proper Disclosure Transparency
title_i18n.zh: Fedora将允许在适当披露透明度的前提下进行人工智能辅助贡献。
title_i18n.es: Fedora permitirá contribuciones asistidas por inteligencia artificial con la debida transparencia en la divulgación.

excerpt_i18n.en: Fedora will now permit AI-assisted contributions with proper disclosure to maintain transparency and integrity in the open-source community.
excerpt_i18n.zh: Fedora 项目宣布将允许在适当披露透明度的前提下接受 AI 辅助的代码贡献。这一政策旨在平衡创新与开源社区的诚信要求，确保贡献者明确标注 AI 参与的部分。

items.title: Streamline code migration using Amazon Nova Premier with an agentic workflow
items.raw_excerpt: In this post, we demonstrate how Amazon Nova Premier with Amazon Bedrock can systematically migrate legacy C code to modern Java/Spring applications using an intelligent agentic workflow that breaks down complex conversions into specialized agent roles. The solution reduces migration time and costs while improving code quality through automated validation, security assessment, and iterative refinement processes that handle even large codebases exceeding token limitations.

title_i18n.zh: 借助亚马逊Nova Premier的智能工作流，简化代码迁移流程。
title_i18n.es: Optimiza la migración de código con Amazon Nova Premier mediante un flujo de trabajo autónomo.

excerpt_i18n.en: In this post, we demonstrate how Amazon Nova Premier with Amazon Bedrock can systematically migrate legacy C code to modern Java/Spring applications using an intelligent agentic workflow that breaks down complex conversions into specialized agent roles. The solution reduces migration time and costs while improving code quality through automated validation, security assessment, and iterative refinement processes that handle even large codebases exceeding token limitations.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 在这篇文章中，我们展示了Amazon Nova Premier与Amazon Bedrock如何通过智能代理工作流，系统地将遗留C代码迁移至现代Java/Spring应用，该工作流能分解复杂的转换过程。
excerpt_i18n.es: En esta publicación, demostramos cómo Amazon Nova Premier con Amazon Bedrock puede migrar sistemáticamente código C heredado a aplicaciones modernas de Java/Spring mediante un flujo de trabajo agente inteligente que descompone conversiones complejas.

items.title: AI Models Get Brain Rot, Too
items.raw_excerpt: A new study shows that feeding large language models low-quality, high-engagement content from social media lowers their cognitive abilities.

title_i18n.en: AI Models Get Brain Rot, Too
title_i18n.zh: 人工智能模型也出现脑退化现象
title_i18n.es: Los modelos de IA también sufren deterioro cerebral.

excerpt_i18n.en: A new study shows that feeding large language models low-quality, high-engagement content from social media lowers their cognitive abilities.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 一项新研究显示，用社交媒体上低质量高互动内容喂养大型语言模型会降低其认知能力。
excerpt_i18n.es: Un nuevo estudio demuestra que alimentar a los grandes modelos lingüísticos con contenido de baja calidad y alto compromiso procedente de las redes sociales reduce sus capacidades cognitivas.

items.title: The next chapter for UK sovereign AI
items.raw_excerpt: OpenAI expands its UK partnership with a new Ministry of Justice agreement, bringing ChatGPT to civil servants. It also introduces UK data residency for ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Edu, and the API Platform to support trusted and secure AI adoption.

title_i18n.en: The next chapter for UK sovereign AI
title_i18n.zh: 英国主权人工智能的新篇章
title_i18n.es: El próximo capítulo para la inteligencia artificial soberana del Reino Unido

excerpt_i18n.en: OpenAI expands its UK partnership with a new Ministry of Justice agreement, bringing ChatGPT to civil servants. It also introduces UK data residency for ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Edu, and the API Platform to support trusted and secure AI adoption.
excerpt_i18n.zh: OpenAI扩大与英国的合作，新增司法部协议，将ChatGPT引入公务员体系。同时，为ChatGPT企业版、ChatGPT教育版及API平台设立英国数据驻留机制，以支持相关服务。
excerpt_i18n.es: OpenAI amplía su colaboración en el Reino Unido con un nuevo acuerdo del Ministerio de Justicia, llevando ChatGPT a los funcionarios públicos. También introduce residencia de datos en el Reino Unido para ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Edu y la Plataforma API para apoyar la transformación digital.
